bibl.title: Gurutattvamālikā
bibl.persName: GīrvaṇendrasarasvatīGīrvāṇendra Sarasvatī was the kulaguru (family preceptor) of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita, who initiated him into the study of Advaita Vedānta.
bibl.note: Unni, N. Parameswaran (1995). Nilakantha Diksita. Delhi: Sahitya Akademi.

The Gurutattvamālikā is a hymn of 28 stanzas composed in the Śārdūlavikrīḍita metre. It belongs to the tārāvalī / nakṣatramālikā type of composition, in which 27 stanzas correspond to the 27 asterisms (nakṣatras). It praises the guru Gīrvāṇendra Sarasvatī, identified with Śiva and extolled as the disciple's one saviour, able to liberate him from the cycle of birth and death.
